legend: You are given a circle of $$$L = 10^9$$$ cells, numbered around the circle from $$$1$$$ to $$$L$$$ (cells $$$1$$$ and $$$L$$$ are adjacent). There are mines in $$$n$$$ distinct cells; in each test, the mine placement is chosen randomly and uniformly among all sets of $$$n$$$ cells.

You may probe cells. If the probed cell contains a mine, it explodes. In response to a probe of cell $$$i$$$, you learn whether there was a mine there, and the distance $$$d$$$ from $$$i$$$ to some remaining unexploded mine. Which mine is chosen is determined by an unknown rule — it is not necessarily the nearest mine. The distance between cells $$$a$$$ and $$$b$$$ is $$$\min(|a - b|,\, L - |a - b|)$$$.
After making at most $$$30$$$ probes, specify a cell that definitely contains an unexploded mine.
input: The first line contains an integer $$$n$$$ $$$(2 \le n \le 2 \cdot 10^5)$$$ — the number of mines.
output: To make a probe, output "? i" $$$(1 \le i \le L)$$$ and read the response:
"YES d", if cell $$$i$$$ contained a mine (and it exploded),
"NO d", if there was no mine.
Here $$$d$$$ is the distance from $$$i$$$ to some unexploded mine; the mine exploded by this probe is not taken into account.

You can make at most $$$30$$$ probes. To give the final answer, output "! i" and terminate the program: at that moment, cell $$$i$$$ must contain an unexploded mine. The final answer does not count toward the probe limit.
Your program will receive the verdict "Wrong answer" in the following cases:
the number of available probes is exceeded;
the output answer is incorrect (the cell does not contain an unexploded mine).
After each query, you must flush the output buffer, otherwise your program will receive the verdict "Idleness Limit Exceeded":
C++: std::endl when using iostream (cout « ... « endl), fflush(stdout) after output using stdio (printf);
Java: System.out.println(...), and when using another stream (PrintWriter, BufferedWriter) — call its flush() after each line;
Python: print(..., flush=True), and read the interactor's responses using input().
note: Example. There are mines in cells $$$1$$$, $$$5$$$, $$$12$$$, and $$$100$$$ on the circle (the program does not know these positions; it only sees $$$n = 4$$$).

For the query "? 1", the interactor responds "YES 4": cell $$$1$$$ contained a mine and it exploded (the distances to mines $$$5$$$, $$$12$$$, and $$$100$$$ are $$$4$$$, $$$11$$$, and $$$99$$$ respectively; the interactor chose mine $$$5$$$ and returned the distance to it);
For the repeated query "? 1", the interactor responds "NO 11": there is no mine in cell $$$1$$$ anymore, and the distance to mine $$$12$$$, which the interactor chose, is $$$11$$$;
For the query "? 13", the interactor responds "NO 1": there is no mine in cell $$$13$$$, the interactor chose mine $$$12$$$ and returned the distance to it;

the program outputs "! 12" and terminates — the answer is correct, since this cell contains an unexploded mine. In total, $$$3$$$ probes were made out of the allowed $$$30$$$ (the query "! 12" does not count toward this limit).

This example shows that the distance $$$d$$$ in the interactor's response is the distance to some (not necessarily the nearest) unexploded mine, and that you cannot output an already exploded mine as the answer.
The strategy for finding an unexploded mine used in the example is not necessarily optimal.

legend.ai: 给定一个由 $$$L = 10^9$$$ 个格子组成的圆环，格子沿圆环依次编号为 $$$1$$$ 到 $$$L$$$(格子 $$$1$$$ 和 $$$L$$$ 相邻)。其中 $$$n$$$ 个不同的格子里埋有地雷；每次测试中，地雷的位置都从所有由 $$$n$$$ 个格子组成的集合中等概率随机选取。
你可以探测格子。如果探测的格子中有地雷，它就会爆炸。探测格子 $$$i$$$ 后，你会得知其中是否有地雷，以及从 $$$i$$$ 到某个尚未爆炸的地雷的距离 $$$d$$$。具体选中哪个地雷由一条未知规则决定，不一定是最近的地雷。格子 $$$a$$$ 和 $$$b$$$ 之间的距离为 $$$\min(|a - b|,\, L - |a - b|)$$$。
最多进行 $$$30$$$ 次探测后，指出一个确定含有未爆炸地雷的格子。

input.ai: 第一行包含一个整数 $$$n$$$ $$$(2 \le n \le 2 \cdot 10^5)$$$，表示地雷的数量。

output.ai: 要进行一次探测，输出 "? i" $$$(1 \le i \le L)$$$ 并读取响应：
如果单元格 $$$i$$$ 中有一枚地雷(并且它爆炸了)，则输出“YES d”，
这里 $$$d$$$ 表示从 $$$i$$$ 到某个未爆地雷的距离；不计入被此探测器引爆的地雷。
你最多可以进行 $$$30$$$ 次探测。要给出最终答案，请输出“! i”并终止程序：此时，格子 $$$i$$$ 中必须有一颗尚未引爆的地雷。最终答案不计入探测次数。
在以下情况下，你的程序将收到“答案错误”（Wrong answer）判定：
输出的答案不正确（该单元格中没有未爆炸的地雷）。
每次查询后都必须刷新输出缓冲区，否则程序会收到“Idleness Limit Exceeded”判定：
C++：使用 iostream 时输出 std::endl（cout « ... « endl），使用 stdio 输出后调用 fflush(stdout)（printf）；
Java：使用 `System.out.println(...)`；如果使用其他输出流（`PrintWriter`、`BufferedWriter`），则在每行输出后调用其 `flush()`；
Python：使用 print(..., flush=True) 输出，并使用 input() 读取交互器的响应。

note.ai: 对于查询 "? 1"，交互器回答 "YES 4"：单元格 $$$1$$$ 中有一枚地雷，它爆炸了(到地雷 $$$5$$$、$$$12$$$ 和 $$$100$$$ 的距离分别为 $$$4$$$、$$$11$$$ 和 $$$99$$$；交互器选择了地雷 $$$5$$$ 并返回了到它的距离)；
对于重复的询问“? 1”，交互器回复“NO 11”：单元格 $$$1$$$ 中已没有地雷，且到交互器选择的地雷 $$$12$$$ 的距离为 $$$11$$$；
对于查询 "? 13"，交互器回应 "NO 1"：单元格 $$$13$$$ 中没有地雷，交互器选择了地雷 $$$12$$$ 并返回了到它的距离；
程序输出“! 12”并终止——答案正确，因为该格子里有一枚未爆炸的地雷。总共进行了 $$$3$$$ 次探测，未超过允许的 $$$30$$$ 次(查询“! 12”不计入此限制)。
这个例子表明，交互器响应中的距离 $$$d$$$ 是到某个尚未爆炸的地雷的距离(不一定是最近的)，并且你不能将已经爆炸的地雷作为答案输出。
示例中用于寻找未爆炸地雷的策略不一定是最优的。
